scope: Monza qualifying, every ranked driver with a selected timed lap; 2023–2026. Same circuit; no cross-track accuracy claim.
method: Stable-gear median RPM/road-speed; ratios relative to highest sufficiently sampled gear. Whole-team/year gear-channel holdout; nearest training gear distance-weighted median speed. No RPM used by predictor.
absoluteRatioLimitation: Loaded tyre radius and final-drive ratio were not verified. RPM/speed is an effective overall ratio including wheel radius, final drive and slip, not an absolute gearbox ratio.
